character.name: Idle
character.prompt: 28×28 pixel-art dungeon-management game character. Small hunched goblin dungeon worker, olive-green skin, oversized pointed ears, crooked nose, messy dark hair, simple brown leather clothing, tiny tool belt. Facing three-quarters toward camera. Chunky readable silhouette, exaggerated hands and head, two-tone shading. Goblin Skin #5c8a45 as primary color, Guild Hall Brown #6b4a2a for clothing, Void Black #0d0d0d for outline. Dark-fantasy but charming. No weapon. Transparent background. Hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing.
